rows: Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN) - Cooking Cost [AP52]
corrections.why: The sample was internally inconsistent: these two school-feeding rows were labelled Education & Learning while Tamil Nadu's 10 Puratchi Thalaivar MGR Nutritious Meal rows, which feed the same age group, were labelled Women and Child. myScheme's own 12 mid-day-meal records split 4 Women and Child, 3 Health, 2 Social welfare and 2 Education with no majority, so the convention was fixed by hand and applied to the whole sample: feeding a child is Women and Child, feeding an old age pensioner is Social welfare. Disclosed because a ground truth corrected after seeing results is only legitimate if the correction and its reason are visible.

rule: The sector is the domain of the benefit the row buys, chosen from the 15 myScheme values and following myScheme's own conventions where its 4,771 records are consistent: a scholarship or fee to a student is Education & Learning whatever department pays it; a pension, marriage grant or relief payment is Social welfare & Empowerment; anything for a farmer, fisherman or animal is Agriculture,Rural & Environment; child feeding, anganwadi, creche and maternity are Women and Child; a loan, insurance or interest subvention is Banking,Financial Services and Insurance; Social welfare & Empowerment is the residual and never the first choice. `none` means no sector fits the row at all, which is true of budget lines like 'Actual Recoveries' and 'Mauritius'. `uncertain` means the row's own evidence did not settle it. Neither counts towards accuracy.
sampling: Stratified: a systematic every-nth sample of the key-sorted rows of each source family, 90 central, 90 Tamil Nadu, 50 Kerala, 45 Karnataka, 45 Andhra Pradesh. Systematic rather than random so it is reproducible from the sorted file with no seed. The audits are systematic samples of the classifier's published answers, stratified by DECIDING SIGNAL rather than by family, so that each signal's precision is a count over an audited set rather than an estimate; audit 2 is disjoint from audit 1 and from the stratified sample.
